cards.explanation: The answer is, what is left of the night. The voice calls, "Watchman, what is left of the night?" (Isaiah 21:11). And it asks it twice, like the question can't wait. I think whoever is asking really wants to know how long the dark will last.

The answer is False. The watchman says, "Morning has come, but also the night." (Isaiah 21:12). He doesn't give just one or the other. He gives both, and he leaves it there. I'd be asking a follow-up question too, friends.

The answer is, come back yet again. After "If you would inquire, then inquire." the watchman says, "Come back yet again." (Isaiah 21:12). So the door stays open for another visit. I know a little about waiting around for somebody to come back, friends, and I like that invitation.
